action: Title card. A grinning gap-toothed New Yorker in a crooked ball cap holds up a pizza slice and a giant thumbs-up between the Statue of Liberty and the Empire State Building under serif title lettering.
visual_prompt: A stout middle-aged man with a thick mustache, gap-toothed grin and a dark baseball cap worn askew, in a pinstriped baseball jersey, holding a drooping pizza slice in one hand and giving an oversized thumbs-up with the other; the Statue of Liberty rises on the left and the Empire State Building on the right; elegant serif title text across the top; centered medium shot, eye level.
voiceover: NEW YORK, NEW YORK ...it's a helluva town!

action: A homeless man with wild hair wanders the station concourse carrying a bag and a water bottle as a caption introduces him; a distant commuter checks his phone near a TRAINS sign.
visual_prompt: A middle-aged man with wild unkempt spiky hair, broad build, stained dark t-shirt and sweatpants, carrying a worn bag in one hand and a plastic water bottle in the other, walking through a low-ceilinged station concourse with fluorescent ceiling panels and a large 'TRAINS' directional sign; a small distant figure looks at a phone in the background corridor; medium-wide shot, eye level.
voiceover: A FEW YEARS AGO THERE WAS A HOMELESS MAN WHO SEEMED TO LIVE IN PENN STATION.  HE WOULD JUST WALK AROUND.

location: Penn Station concourse, at an ATM
action: The man drifts to a stop directly behind a balding businessman using an ATM and just stands there as the caption explains his habit.
visual_prompt: A wild-haired broad-built man in a stained dark t-shirt stands silently close behind a gaunt balding older businessman with wire glasses, hooked nose, dark suit and striped tie who is using an ATM machine labeled 'ATM'; low fluorescent station ceiling and distant commuter behind; tight two-shot, eye level, uncomfortable proximity.
voiceover: HE DIDN'T BOTHER ANYBODY. SOMETIMES HE WOULD STOP WALKING NEAR SOMEONE, STAND THERE FOR A WHILE...

location: Penn Station concourse, at an ATM
action: The man erupts in a deafening nonsense bellow inches from the businessman, who spasms in terror at the ATM, hair standing on end.
visual_prompt: A wild-haired broad-built man in a stained dark t-shirt roars with his mouth stretched enormously wide, gap teeth showing, while beside him a gaunt balding businessman in a dark suit and striped tie convulses in shock, eyes bulging, clutching his chest at an ATM; jagged shock lines radiate around the businessman's head; giant bold scream lettering across the top; tight two-shot, eye level.

action: The man sidles up beside a heavyset commuter absorbed in his phone, while the caption describes the supernatural volume of his voice.
visual_prompt: A heavyset man with a dark bowl haircut and a wristwatch, in a t-shirt, squints down at the phone in his hands, unaware of the wild-haired broad-built man in a stained dark t-shirt standing just behind his shoulder with a blank stare; low fluorescent station ceiling; tight two-shot, eye level, dread building.
voiceover: HE SEEMED UNAWARE OF THE MASSIVE, ALMOST SUPERNATURAL VOLUME OF HIS SHOUTING VOICE.  IT COULD BE HEARD BY JACKHAMMER CREWS ABOVE AT STREET LEVEL
performance: Deadpan setup for the next blast

action: The man unleashes the bellow again; the commuter shrieks, eyes popping, fumbling his phone into the air.
visual_prompt: A wild-haired broad-built man in a stained dark t-shirt roars with a cavernous open mouth while a heavyset man with a dark bowl haircut recoils in wide-eyed screaming panic, hands flung up, his dark phone tumbling midair; sweat drops flying; giant bold scream lettering across the top; tight two-shot, eye level.

action: A silhouetted bystander reports the distressed man to a mustached officer at the NYPD information desk, who shrugs that they keep throwing him out but he keeps coming back.
visual_prompt: A wiry police officer with slicked dark hair, a thick mustache and protruding teeth, in a collared uniform shirt with shoulder patches, gestures with open palms behind a tall counter marked 'NYPD INFORMATION'; in the right foreground the dark silhouette of a bystander's head and shoulders with a bold exclamation mark beside it; station ceiling and TRAINS sign faint behind; over-the-shoulder medium shot, slight low angle.

dialogue.speaker: nypd_officer
dialogue.line: WE KEEP THROWING HIM OUT BUT HE KEEPS COMING BACK.  GOT A HARD-ON FOR THIS PLACE.

voiceover: A BYSTANDER INFORMED THE POLICE THAT THERE WAS A DISTRESSED MAN WHO COULD USE MEDICAL ASSISTANCE.
